plan.nickname: Shereen — Elif's misspelling on the card, which Shirin had printed on her robe and registered with the circuit
plan.detail: One thank-you card, cream with a gold horseshoe, posted to all fourteen fighters in the stable after the Laredo show; thirteen spelled right, hers written 'Shereen'

opener.text: Where did they all go, Elif? Weren't there nine of them in that row?
Did any of them stay for the walkout, or just for yours?
Is that the same row you booked for the Laredo show?

personal.text: Can you hear how he's saying it, Elif? Is that how you wrote it on the card?
Fourteen cards, and thirteen right. Which one did you think wouldn't be standing over you?
You saw that right hand late, didn't you? Did you read the card before you sealed it, or after?
How long did the horseshoe take you? Longer than the S-H-I?

closer.text: Should I leave the card with your corner, or do you want me to keep it another four years?
Would you sign it the same way now?
Is that us square, Marco, or do I owe you for the stamp?
Do you want it, or shall I have it framed next to the robe?
